name: strawberry-core-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is `strawberry`, a Python library for GraphQL: you describe a schema with
Python classes and type annotations, build a `strawberry.Schema` from them, print it as SDL and
execute GraphQL operations against it in process. The web-framework integrations, subscription
transports, federation and the command-line tools are not part of this task.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation within strawberry's core.
Everything in scope is strawberry's core for building a GraphQL schema from Python types and executing operations against it in process: the strawberry package's top-level modules (__init__, annotation, directive, parent, permission, resolvers, scalars, schema_directive and schema_directives), its types, schema, printer, relay, utils, field_extensions and execution packages, and its extensions package apart from the tracing, pyinstrument and pydantic error extensions; together with the documentation pages docs/types (enums, generics, input-types, interfaces, lazy, maybe, object-types, operation-directives, private, resolvers, scalars, schema-configurations, schema-directives, schema, union and unset), docs/general (schema-basics, queries and mutations), docs/guides (permissions, errors, custom-extensions, field-extensions, accessing-parent-data, convert-to-dictionary and relay) and docs/extensions (add-validation-rules, disable-introspection, disable-validation, input-mutation, mask-errors, max-aliases-limiter, max-tokens-limiter, par
